cities.name: Sydney, Australia
cities.description: A vibrant coastal metropolis famous for the Sydney Opera House, Harbour Bridge, and Bondi Beach.

cities.name: Melbourne, Australia
cities.description: Australia's cultural capital known for its art-lined laneways, coffee culture, and royal botanic gardens.

cities.name: Tokyo, Japan
cities.description: A dynamic blend of neon-lit skyscrapers, historic shrines, and world-renowned culinary districts.

cities.name: Kyoto, Japan
cities.description: Famous for classical Buddhist temples, bamboo forests, imperial palaces, and traditional wooden houses.

temples.name: Angkor Wat, Cambodia
temples.description: The largest religious monument in the world, renowned for its grand Khmer architecture and sunrise views.

temples.name: Taj Mahal, India
temples.description: An iconic ivory-white marble mausoleum on the banks of the Yamuna river, symbolizing eternal love.

beaches.name: Bora Bora, French Polynesia
beaches.description: Turquoise lagoons, coral reefs, and overwater bungalows surrounding the dramatic peaks of Mount Otemanu.

beaches.name: Copacabana Beach, Brazil
beaches.description: A lively 4-kilometer crescent beach famous for its wave-patterned promenade and golden sands.
